qualitative.gate_2_reason: Societal / legislative acceptance risk (addictive or predatory model).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (REJECT). Core economic model is retail CFD trading and financial spread betting where >70% of retail clients lose money. Explicitly disqualified under Gate 2 rubric as an addictive/predatory model subject to severe societal, regulatory, and legislative ruin risk.
qualitative.evidence: IG Group derives the majority of its net trading revenue from OTC leveraged derivatives (CFDs and financial spread bets) offered to retail investors. Global regulators (FCA, ESMA, ASIC) have repeatedly instituted leverage limits, negative balance protection mandates, and advertising bans to protect retail consumers from systemic trading losses, representing an unhedgeable terminal regulatory overhang.
